label: Langtang yak cheese
note: Swiss-style cheese made at Kyangjin since the 1950s; taught by Swiss cheesemakers (Werner Schulthess, Sepp Dubach), Swiss project handed to the government in 1964

about.text: A hard cheese of the Langtang valley in Nepal, made from yak and nak (female yak) milk by the Swiss method that Swiss cheesemakers brought to Kyangjin in the 1950s.
